paper_title: Self-Stabilizing Weakly Byzantine Perpetual Gathering of Mobile Agents
statement: Despite these results, the solvability of the SS-PGAT without global knowledge remains an open problem.
context: Our findings show that no algorithm can solve the GAT without global knowledge, and no algorithm can solve the SS-GAT for any k and f with n, k, f , and Λg . On the other hand, for the SS-PGAT, we provided an algorithm that solves the problem with N , K, F , and Λg , where these values represent the upper bounds of n, k, and f , respectively. The time complexity of our proposed algorithm is O(K · F · tREN (2Λg )). Despite these results, the solvability of the SS-PGAT without global knowledge remains an open problem.
